source_reference: UI-02/UI-09 Pin to Screen controls; PinPreviewCard public scale/opacity exports
fixture: Synthetic ImageDocument with known dimensions and scale/opacity boundary values.
trigger: Pin the document and exercise 50/100/200%, semi-transparent, invalid and out-of-range controls.
target_observation_needed: Record window placement, stacking, persistence, transparency and clamping behavior.
ferby_observation_needed: Record clampPinScale/clampPinOpacity outputs, rendered dimensions and callback values.
acceptance_rule: Compare visual and callback behavior only against separately recorded target results.
limitations: PinPreviewCard exposes a preview component, not native window placement, stacking or persistence.

source_reference: UI-07 library storyboard, search, File List and tile-size labels
fixture: Synthetic set of image documents with duplicate names, missing metadata and tile-size variants.
trigger: Search, switch File List/small/medium/large tiles and select an item.
target_observation_needed: Record source folder, persistence, metadata/search scope and actions.
ferby_observation_needed: Record whether PinPreviewCard receives stable document IDs and rendered metadata; library behavior is separately marked absent.
acceptance_rule: Compare library ordering, filtering and persistence only after both implementations are observed.
limitations: The named file exports no library, search, folder or tile-list API.

source_reference: UI-16 Edit, Copy, Save, Upload, OCR, Pin and Close labels; PinPreviewCard callbacks
fixture: Synthetic ImageDocument with isolated action callback spies and a close transition.
trigger: Invoke Edit Image, Copy Image and Close Pin from the preview.
target_observation_needed: Record thumbnail lifetime and transitions to editor/pin plus copy/save/OCR action outcomes.
ferby_observation_needed: Record exact callback IDs and preview unmount/transition behavior.
acceptance_rule: Compare callback identity and transitions only with recorded target behavior; absent actions remain unknown.
limitations: The named props expose edit/copy/close only; Save, Upload, OCR and Pin are not exported here.
